note: Both sets extract a large number of claims from the text and the table, but both also contain several errors. Set A misreads a few numbers (e.g., 28.324 m instead of 38.234 m, and 556.587 instead of 5590.87) and uses the wrong unit (N*m^3) for some stiffness values. Set B also uses the wrong unit (N*m^3) for stiffness, incorrectly assigns the shear modulus value to Young's modulus, and confuses the top diameter with the top thickness.
